conviction_note: Q3 2026 is new (no pre-release, no numeric guide). The lean is mildly negative: Italian spot gas (PSV) roughly doubled year on year by September, and the last time energy outran Zignago's pricing (Q1 2025) margins went from 21.8% to 14.2% and the stock fell 10.3% on the day. O-I's Southern Europe/wine weakness points the same way. Three things hold p_up near 50: Verallia's Italy held steady, Zignago's own Q2 grew against an easy Q3 2025 comparison, and hedging is undisclosed and unknown. The stock is also already down 12% since the H1 print, and four of its last five release days closed up. With abs 5.5 and p_up 43 the scaled number is -0.77. The findings sum to -1.6 because each is sized alone. The gap is the reaction-history pull toward 50, not an inconsistency.

findings.finding: Italian wholesale gas (PSV) stepped up sharply in Q3 2026. September 2026 month-to-date averaged 75.4 EUR/MWh against 0.373 EUR/Smc (about 35 EUR/MWh) in September 2025, and August MTD averaged 58.3 EUR/MWh against 0.381 EUR/Smc. Q2 was far milder: June MTD 45.0 against 0.422 EUR/Smc. So Q3 carries an energy shock Q2 did not. Zignago itself flagged 'pressioni rialziste sui prezzi' from Middle East tension in its H1 release, and the last comparable shock (Q1 2025) cut its EBITDA margin from 21.8% to 14.2%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2025 (released 2025-05-07): margin collapsed on energy costs, EBITDA 22m against 21.8% margin a year earlier, and the stock closed -10.33% that day (https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/zignago-vetro-la-marginalita-crolla-nel-primo-trimestre-del-2025-pesa-l-aumento-di-costi-dell-202505071317438069). When margins later recovered, release days closed +4.28% (2026-03-12), +4.04% (2026-05-06) and +6.15% (2026-07-30).
findings.original_quote: Zignago H1 2026 release: 'Le recenti tensioni in Medio Oriente introducono tuttavia elementi di incertezza sulle filiere di approvvigionamento di petrolio, gas e derivati, con conseguenti pressioni rialziste sui prezzi di mercato, che il Gruppo continua a monitorare per adottare tempestive azioni di mitigazione.' (Recent Middle East tensions add uncertainty to oil, gas and derivative supply chains, with upward pressure on market prices that the Group is monitoring in order to mitigate.) PSV: 'Media MTD (2026-09)' 0,80632 €/Smc (75,42 €/MWh) against September 2025 0,37336 €/Smc.
findings.why_not_priced: Gas prices are public, but Zignago discloses neither its hedge ratio nor its energy pass-through, and roughly two analysts cover it. If the market had priced a Q1-2025-style margin hit, the stock would be at or below its October low of 6.39 rather than up 6.7% over 20 days to 6.70, and the short register would show building positions (it shows one 0.5% holder, unchanged). Partly priced: the stock is down 12% from 7.60 after the H1 print.

findings.finding: Peers that reported after Zignago's H1 show weak Southern European glass demand in Q3 2026. O-I's Europe segment profit fell from $95m to $2m, with price -3.8%, tons -3.7%, and 'Southern Europe remained under pressure, particularly in wine'. Verallia's Southern and Western Europe 'slipped into negative territory' on a weak wine summer, though Verallia said Italy held steady with its new Pescia furnace. Net of that offset, the read-through for Zignago's Italian food and beverage business (and its wine-bottle lines) is mildly negative on volume and price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2025 (2025-07-24, weak demand) closed -2.19% on the day. Q3 2025 (2025-11-06, revenue -2%) closed +1.47% and fell another -6.21% the next day, outside a one-session window.
findings.why_not_priced: O-I is US-listed, and Zignago did not react: it closed +2.35% on 10-27 and -0.6% on 10-28. Either the read-through was ignored or it was offset by Verallia's 'Italy held steady'. A priced read-through would show a down move on the 10-28 session.

findings.finding: Zignago's own trajectory into Q3 is positive against an easy comparison. Q2 2026 revenue was 157.1m (+2.6% yoy, +7% qoq) and Q2 EBITDA 30.5m (+4.2% yoy). The July outlook expected demand to support 'elevato utilizzo della capacità produttiva', and the Q3 2025 base is soft (revenue -2% yoy, EBITDA 27.0m, -6.4%). Revenue and volume are therefore likely flat to up yoy even if margin slips.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Release days with volume and margin recovery closed up: +4.28% (2026-03-12), +4.04% (2026-05-06), +6.15% (2026-07-30). The H1 day partly reversed the next session (-2.11%).

Also: 'Nel secondo trimestre i ricavi sono stati pari a 157,1 milioni di euro, +10,3 milioni di euro (+7%) rispetto al primo trimestre'.
